Manifest.Name: VA-11 Hall-A同人MOD/VA-11 Hall-A Fan MOD
Manifest.Author: TAS-4715-2
Manifest.Description: 赛博朋克酒保行动 VA11-Hall-A 同人调酒 mod。3×2 的 B.T.C 调酒台，5 种材料 + 加冰/陈化/摇和调出 24 款饮品（标准杯 / 大杯），23 位顾客会上门点单，Jill 与 Dana 按天数推进剧情（含调酒教学与对话分支），附内嵌 B.T.C 配方书。支持中文与英文，游戏内切换语言即生效。素材与角色版权属于 Sukeban Games，详见包内 README.md。 English: A VA-11 Hall-A fan mod for Probably Stolen. A 3×2 B.T.C mixing station with 5 ingredients and ice / aging / shaking, yielding 24 drinks (standard cup or BIG cup). 23 clients drop by to order, while Jill and Dana's story advances day by day, including the mixing tutorial and dialogue branches, plus a built-in B.T.C recipe book. Available in Chinese and English — switch the game language and the mod follows. Characters and assets belong to Sukeban Games; see README.md in the package.
